title: Krish Pandey
text:
Hi! I’m Krish Pandey, an undergraduate studying Statistics & Data Science at UC Santa Barbara. I’m interested in AI, product development, and data-driven decision making: figuring out what’s worth building, then using data to know whether it’s working.
Right now I’m a Product Intern at Leap Orbit, where I’m writing the product requirements for a new healthcare product. I’m also a Resident Assistant at UCSB and lead STEM outreach for K-8 students with WEMech.
Take a look at my work on the Projects page, or feel free to reach out. I’d love to connect!
